citation: Classified advertisement, 'Situation wanted—first class French cook in private family. 2001 Indiana-av.'. Chicago Daily Tribune, 4 October 1907 (vol. 66 no. 238).
author: Chicago Daily Tribune
locator: The issue's OCR text (per_chicago-daily-tribune_1907-10-04_66_238), the classified columns; the OCR runs neighbouring advertisements together, so only the words quoted in the note are read from it.

note: A private family's cook at 2001 Indiana Avenue in October 1907: the house was still a residence three years after the scene.
